name: case-study
description: Case Study. Turns the first customer into proof, with their permission. Once the product has shipped, it writes a short before-and-after from their real numbers and their real words, and keeps it marked as a draft until they have approved that exact text in writing. Change a word and it asks again. Use when the user says "case study", "testimonial", "customer story", "get a quote from them", "write up the result", "social proof", "can I use their name", or once a customer has seen results.

findings.excerpt: python3 "${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/casestudy.py" draft --deal north-pier --before "Paid \$6,400 a month to chase invoices" \
